title: Coordinates outside a selected pair
statement: For a natural number $r$ and indices $i,j$ in the finite set $\\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$, let the remaining coordinate set consist of those indices $k$ in that set for which $k\ne i$ and $k\ne j$. The indices $i$ and $j$ are allowed to be equal.
